title: finance.history
description: Get the accumulated time series of polled quote samples for a tracked symbol. The node passively appends one row per symbol per successful poll (~5-minute cadence) and prunes rows older than 90 days; there is no upstream historical-fetch path. First-day installs return an empty points array — empty is not an error; the caller (voice tool / sparkline) decides how to surface it.

symbol.description: US ticker symbol (case-insensitive, normalised to uppercase by the handler). Must be in the node's tracked list.

period.description: Lookback window for points returned. Default '1w' if omitted. 'all' returns the full retained 90-day window.
